transcript:
User: This is Frank. Whoever you people are, I want to know how you got this number.
Agent: Frank, I hear you—getting an unexpected call can feel intrusive. Did you see an ad, fill out a form, or request info about missed calls recently?
User: None of your damn business. I didn’t ask for anything from you liars and thieves.
Agent: I hear you, Frank—I’m not here to argue. Do you want me to remove your number from our list?
User: Yeah, remove it. Guarantees from outfits like yours evaporate when there's a problem. Show me a real customer I can call.
Agent: Got it—I’ll take you off our list. Before I do, what’s the best business name to remove so we don’t contact you again?
User: None of your damn business. Just take my number off your list and don't bother me again.
Agent: Understood, Frank—I won’t contact you again from Dialux. Is there anything else before I let you go?
